about:
# KeyboardScroll
A <cg>QoL mod</cg> that allows you to <cy>switch and scroll</cy> through pages using <cl>customizable keybinds</cl>.

## Features
- <cy>Switch</cy> through pages, <cy>scroll</cy> up and down using <cl>keyboard</cl>
- <cy>Switch</cy> through pages using <cl>Modifier Key</cl> (Shift by default) + <cl>MWheelUP</cl>/<cl>MWheelDown</cl>

## Default keybinds
- Scroll Up: W
- Scroll Down: S
- Next Page: Arrow Right, D
- Previous Page: Arrow Left, A
- Modifier Key: Shift

## Configuration
- Every keybind <cl>can be customized</cl> in the mod settings
- Horizontal mouse scroll feature can be <cl>enabled</cl>/<cl>disabled</cl>
- Configurable keyboard <cl>scroll sensitivity</cl> (when scrolling up/down)
- Option to <cl>enable</cl>/<cl>disable</cl> page scroll spam when holding navigation keys

### Known limitations
- Page switching (A/D) supports most major menus, but may not work in certain specific layouts.
- Custom page buttons from other mods may not be supported due to different unique Node IDs (e.g., `author.mod-name/button-id`).

### Support
Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/y8fqT5bP6c) for support & bug reports
changelog:
# 1.2.1
* Keyboard scrolling is now automatically deactivated inside `LevelEditorLayer`

# 1.2.0
* Added `Disable Page Scroll Spam` setting to control page scrolling on key hold
* Fixed an issue where using arrow keys (`Right`/`Left`) as page-switching binds caused double input in some menus
* Set right and left arrow keys as default keybinds for `Next Page` and `Previous Page` actions

# 1.1.1
* Fixed an issue where holding a modifier while using vertical keyboard scroll triggered infinite page scrolling

# 1.1.0
* Added `Invert Scroll Direction` setting for horizontal mouse scrolling
* Made performance and memory optimizations

# 1.0.2
* Fixed an issue that caused repeated scroll events when using the modifier-triggered page scroll alongside the `prevter.smooth-scroll` mod

# 1.0.1
* Added missing `"left"` and `"right"` button IDs to fix page switching on specific layers

# 1.0.0
* Initial release
